passages.text: Now the angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bochim and said, “I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land that I had promised to your fathers, and I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you, and you are not to make a covenant with the people of this land, but you shall tear down their altars.’ Yet you have not obeyed My voice. What is this you have done?
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD appeared.
The angel came up from Gilgal to Bochim.
The angel spoke to the Israelites.
The angel said, “I brought you out of Egypt.
I led you into this land.
I promised this land to your fathers.
I said, ‘I will never break My covenant with you.’
I commanded you, ‘Do not make a covenant with the people of this land.’
I told you, ‘Tear down their altars.’
You did not obey My voice.
What have you done?”
passages.original: וַיַּ֧עַל מַלְאַךְ־ יְהוָ֛ה מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּ֖ל אֶל־ הַבֹּכִ֑ים פ וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִמִּצְרַ֗יִם וָאָבִ֤יא אֶתְכֶם֙ אֶל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִשְׁבַּ֙עְתִּי֙ לַאֲבֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וָאֹמַ֕ר לֹֽא־ אָפֵ֧ר בְּרִיתִ֛י אִתְּכֶ֖ם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ וְאַתֶּ֗ם לֹֽא־ תִכְרְת֤וּ בְרִית֙ לְיֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֔את מִזְבְּחוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם תִּתֹּצ֑וּן וְלֹֽא־ שְׁמַעְתֶּ֥ם בְּקֹלִ֖י מַה־ זֹּ֥את עֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃

passages.text: So now I tell you that I will not drive out these people before you; they will be thorns in your sides, and their gods will be a snare to you.”
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke to the Israelites.
The angel said, "I will not drive out these people before you.
These people will be thorns in your sides.
Their gods will be a snare to you."
passages.original: וְגַ֣ם אָמַ֔רְתִּי לֹֽא־ אֲגָרֵ֥שׁ אוֹתָ֖ם מִפְּנֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָי֤וּ לָכֶם֙ לְצִדִּ֔ים וֵאלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם יִהְי֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ׃

passages.text: When the angel of the LORD had spoken these words to all the Israelites, the people lifted up their voices and wept.
passages.sermon:
The angel of the LORD spoke these words to all the Israelites.
The people heard the words.
The people lifted up their voices.
The people wept.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֗י כְּדַבֵּ֞ר מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הָעָ֛ם אֶת־ קוֹלָ֖ם וַיִּבְכּֽוּ׃

passages.text: So they called that place Bochim and offered sacrifices there to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites heard the words of the angel of the LORD.
They wept.
They named that place Bochim.
They offered sacrifices to the LORD at Bochim.
passages.original: וַֽיִּקְרְא֛וּ שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בֹּכִ֑ים וַיִּזְבְּחוּ־ שָׁ֖ם לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: After Joshua had dismissed the people, the Israelites went out to take possession of the land, each to his own inheritance.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
Joshua dismissed the people.
The Israelites left.
Each Israelite went to his own inheritance.
Each Israelite went to take possession of the land.
passages.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֥ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶת־ הָעָ֑ם וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אִ֥ישׁ לְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ לָרֶ֥שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And the people served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and of the elders who outlived him, who had seen all the great works that the LORD had done for Israel.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel served the LORD.
They served Him during the lifetime of Joshua.
Joshua was their leader.
They also served the LORD during the days of the elders who lived after Joshua.
These elders lived a long time after Joshua died.
These elders had seen all the great works of the LORD.
The LORD had done these great works for Israel.
passages.original: וַיַּעַבְד֤וּ הָעָם֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֹ֣ל׀ יְמֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשׁ֔וּעַ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָא֗וּ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the LORD, died at the age of 110.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the son of Nun.
Joshua served the LORD.
Joshua died.
He was 110 years old.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה בֶּן־ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃

passages.text: They buried him in the land of his inheritance, at Timnath-heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the servant of the LORD.
He died at the age of 110.
The people buried Joshua.
They buried him in the land he inherited.
This land was at Timnath-heres.
Timnath-heres was in the hill country of Ephraim.
It was north of Mount Gaash.
passages.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אוֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔וֹ בְּתִמְנַת־ חֶ֖רֶס בְּהַ֣ר אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְהַר־ גָּֽעַשׁ׃

passages.text: After that whole generation had also been gathered to their fathers, another generation rose up who did not know the LORD or the works that He had done for Israel.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the servant of the LORD.
Joshua died at the age of 110.
The people buried Joshua in his own land.
They buried him at Timnath-heres.
Timnath-heres was in the hill country of Ephraim.
It was north of Mount Gaash.
All the people from Joshua’s generation died.
They joined their ancestors in death.
A new generation grew up after them.
This new generation did not know the LORD.
They did not know what the LORD had done for Israel.
passages.original: וְגַם֙ כָּל־ הַדּ֣וֹר הַה֔וּא נֶאֶסְפ֖וּ אֶל־ אֲבוֹתָ֑יו וַיָּקָם֩ דּ֨וֹר אַחֵ֜ר אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹא־ יָֽדְעוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וְגַם֙ אֶת־ הַֽמַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: And the Israelites did evil in the sight of the LORD and served the Baals.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
They did what was evil.
The LORD saw their evil actions.
The Israelites served the Baals.
Baals were false gods worshiped by the nations around them.
passages.original: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־ הַבְּעָלִֽים׃

passages.text: Thus they forsook the LORD, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they followed after various gods of the peoples around them. They bowed down to them and provoked the LORD to anger, for they forsook Him and served Baal and the Ashtoreths.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites left the LORD.
The LORD was the God of their fathers.
The LORD brought their fathers out of Egypt.
The Israelites followed other gods.
These gods belonged to the nations around them.
The Israelites bowed down to these other gods.
The Israelites made the LORD angry.
They left the LORD.
They served Baal.
They served the Ashtoreths.
passages.original: וַיַּעַזְב֞וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה׀ אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתָ֗ם הַמּוֹצִ֣יא אוֹתָם֮ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַיִם֒ וַיֵּלְכ֞וּ אַחֲרֵ֣י׀ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֗ים מֵאֱלֹהֵ֤י הָֽעַמִּים֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ סְבִיב֣וֹתֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיַּכְעִ֖סוּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃ וַיַּעַזְב֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ לַבַּ֖עַל וְלָעַשְׁתָּרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Then the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He delivered them into the hands of those who plundered them. He sold them into the hands of their enemies all around, whom they were no longer able to resist.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD became very angry with Israel.
The LORD gave Israel into the hands of people who plundered them.
These plunderers attacked and took from Israel.
The LORD sold Israel into the hands of their enemies who surrounded them.
Israel could not stand against their enemies anymore.
passages.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיִּתְּנֵם֙ בְּיַד־ שֹׁסִ֔ים וַיָּשֹׁ֖סּוּ אוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵ֞ם בְּיַ֤ד אֽוֹיְבֵיהֶם֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב וְלֹֽא־ יָכְל֣וּ ע֔וֹד לַעֲמֹ֖ד לִפְנֵ֥י אוֹיְבֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Wherever Israel marched out, the hand of the LORD was against them to bring calamity, just as He had sworn to them. So they were greatly distressed.
passages.sermon:
Israel is the subject.
Israel had turned away from the LORD.
The LORD is the God who brought their ancestors out of Egypt.
Wherever Israel went out, the LORD acted against them.
The LORD brought trouble upon them.
The LORD did this to harm them.
The LORD had spoken these warnings to them before.
The LORD had sworn these things would happen.
Israel suffered greatly.
Israel was very distressed.
passages.original: בְּכֹ֣ל׀ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָצְא֗וּ יַד־ יְהוָה֙ הָיְתָה־ בָּ֣ם לְרָעָ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וְכַאֲשֶׁ֛ר נִשְׁבַּ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה לָהֶ֑ם וַיֵּ֥צֶר לָהֶ֖ם מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: Then the LORD raised up judges, who saved them from the hands of those who plundered them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD became angry with Israel because they disobeyed Him.
The LORD raised up judges for Israel.
These judges led Israel.
The judges saved Israel from those who plundered them.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥קֶם יְהוָ֖ה שֹֽׁפְטִ֑ים וַיּ֣וֹשִׁיע֔וּם מִיַּ֖ד שֹׁסֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Israel, however, did not listen to their judges. Instead, they prostituted themselves with other gods and bowed down to them. They quickly turned from the way of their fathers, who had walked in obedience to the LORD’s commandments; they did not do as their fathers had done.
passages.sermon:
Israel did not listen to their judges.
Israel turned away from their judges.
Israel followed other gods.
Israel worshiped these other gods.
Israel quickly left the way of their fathers.
Their fathers had obeyed the LORD’s commandments.
Israel did not obey the LORD’s commandments as their fathers had done.
passages.original: וְגַ֤ם אֶל־ שֹֽׁפְטֵיהֶם֙ לֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ כִּ֣י זָנ֗וּ אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֖וּ לָהֶ֑ם סָ֣רוּ מַהֵ֗ר מִן־ הַדֶּ֜רֶךְ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָלְכ֧וּ אֲבוֹתָ֛ם לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ מִצְוֺת־ יְהוָ֖ה לֹא־ עָ֥שׂוּ כֵֽן׃

passages.text: Whenever the LORD raised up a judge for the Israelites, He was with that judge and saved them from the hands of their enemies while the judge was still alive; for the LORD was moved to pity by their groaning under those who oppressed them and afflicted them.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The Israelites often suffered under their enemies.
The LORD raised up judges for the Israelites.
A judge was a leader chosen by the LORD.
Whenever the LORD raised up a judge, He stayed with that judge.
The LORD helped the judge save the Israelites from their enemies.
The LORD did this while the judge was still alive.
The LORD felt pity for the Israelites.
The Israelites groaned because their enemies oppressed and afflicted them.
The LORD acted because He was moved by their suffering.
passages.original: וְכִֽי־ הֵקִ֨ים יְהוָ֥ה׀ לָהֶם֮ שֹֽׁפְטִים֒ וְהָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ עִם־ הַשֹּׁפֵ֔ט וְהֽוֹשִׁיעָם֙ מִיַּ֣ד אֹֽיְבֵיהֶ֔ם כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י הַשּׁוֹפֵ֑ט כִּֽי־ יִנָּחֵ֤ם יְהוָה֙ מִנַּֽאֲקָתָ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֥י לֹחֲצֵיהֶ֖ם וְדֹחֲקֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: But when the judge died, the Israelites became even more corrupt than their fathers, going after other gods to serve them and bow down to them. They would not give up their evil practices and stubborn ways.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites lived under the leadership of judges.
When a judge died, the Israelites changed their behavior.
They became more corrupt than their fathers.
They followed other gods.
They served these other gods.
They bowed down to these other gods.
They did not stop their evil actions.
They did not turn from their stubborn ways.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּמ֣וֹת הַשּׁוֹפֵ֗ט יָשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ וְהִשְׁחִ֣יתוּ מֵֽאֲבוֹתָ֔ם לָלֶ֗כֶת אַֽחֲרֵי֙ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים לְעָבְדָ֖ם וּלְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֣ת לָהֶ֑ם לֹ֤א הִפִּ֙ילוּ֙ מִמַּ֣עַלְלֵיהֶ֔ם וּמִדַּרְכָּ֖ם הַקָּשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He said, “Because this nation has transgressed the covenant I laid down for their fathers and has not heeded My voice, I will no longer drive out before them any of the nations Joshua left when he died.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD became very angry with Israel.
The LORD spoke about Israel.
The LORD said, “This nation has broken My covenant.
I gave this covenant to their fathers.
I commanded their fathers to keep it.
This nation did not listen to My voice.
Because of this, I will not drive out any more nations before them.
Joshua left these nations when he died.
I will not remove these nations from before Israel.”
passages.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֹּ֗אמֶר יַעַן֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָבְר֜וּ הַגּ֣וֹי הַזֶּ֗ה אֶת־ בְּרִיתִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֣יתִי אֶת־ אֲבוֹתָ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ לְקוֹלִֽי׃ גַּם־ אֲנִי֙ לֹ֣א אוֹסִ֔יף לְהוֹרִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ מִפְּנֵיהֶ֑ם מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ עָזַ֥ב יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ וַיָּמֹֽת׃

passages.text: In this way I will test whether Israel will keep the way of the LORD by walking in it as their fathers did.”
passages.sermon:
God wanted to test Israel.
God wanted to see if Israel would obey Him.
God wanted to know if Israel would keep the way of the LORD.
God wanted to see if Israel would walk in His ways.
God wanted to know if Israel would do as their fathers did.
God wanted to see if Israel would follow Him or not.
passages.original: לְמַ֛עַן נַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖ם אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֲשֹׁמְרִ֣ים הֵם֩ אֶת־ דֶּ֨רֶךְ יְהוָ֜ה לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר שָׁמְר֥וּ אֲבוֹתָ֖ם אִם־ לֹֽא׃

passages.text: That is why the LORD had left those nations in place and had not driven them out immediately by delivering them into the hand of Joshua.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD left certain nations in the land of Canaan.
The LORD did not drive out these nations quickly.
The LORD did not give these nations into the hand of Joshua.
passages.original: וַיַּנַּ֤ח יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֣ם הָאֵ֔לֶּה לְבִלְתִּ֥י הוֹרִישָׁ֖ם מַהֵ֑ר וְלֹ֥א נְתָנָ֖ם בְּיַד־ יְהוֹשֻֽׁעַ׃פ
